training_role: dense parametric training grid with harvested truth assets and exploratory weak-band augmentation
notes: This catalog fixes a finite engineering-facing set of target bands instead of claiming arbitrary continuous-band extrapolation.
The current strategy is to densify truth coverage within this catalog and evaluate conditional prediction plus inverse design inside the catalog.
Bands above 180 Hz remain the main supplementation focus because they are harder and were historically under-covered.
As of the current frozen mainline, this catalog is paired with the v8 target-band dataset, RF classifier, HGB regressor, and the band-aware shape front-end.

bands.label: Lower-Mid Anchor
bands.reason: Provides a relatively accessible lower-mid reference band and helps stabilize the conditional predictor.

bands.label: Mid Transition
bands.reason: Bridges the lower-mid and core mid-band regions and is useful for continuity across neighboring targets.

bands.label: Mid Core
bands.reason: This remains the most informative default engineering target and the current optimization showcase band.

bands.label: Upper-Mid Hard
bands.reason: Historically sparse and difficult; gap-diversity augmentation already showed this band benefits strongly from targeted supplementation.

bands.label: High-Mid Selective
bands.reason: Useful for testing whether the model can support more selective high-mid inverse-design requests.

bands.label: High Sparse
bands.reason: Keeps a challenging higher-frequency target in the catalog so supplementation pressure is not limited to the easier mid-band region.
